bays.restriction: Controlled parking zone H (Hampton Court). Permit holders may park in: H “Permit Holders Only”; H “Permit Holders Only” / “Pay and Display”
bays.times: Monday to Sunday including bank holidays 8.30am to 6.30pm (Permit Holders Only Bays operate until 8pm every day)
bays.tariff: Visitor parking by pre-booked session (pay as you go, via RingGo — booking line 020 3046 0005): £1.80 (90p with older person's discount) per session, valid for one session. Visitor scratchcard booklets of 10 are also sold by the council. Richmond Card holders and residents registered with RingGo park free for up to 30 minutes in most Richmond car parks and on-street pay-and-display bays
bays.pay: RingGo visitor sessions (booking line 020 3046 0005) or visitor scratchcards; permits via the council
